plan: reports/2026-10-22_plan_regating-tasks.md; kill conditions from reports/2026-10-22_decision_working-hypothesis-and-two-lines.md; definitions as E18. Filed before any run; never edited after.
states: do-nothing states (target W0 + dW, released subcomponents, Gamma frozen, Delta out of the masked model) of 10-step arm-A fine-tunes of all 24 matrices, Adam 3e-5, batch 32, seed 0. Emoticon (G1, first, alone); ladder ('r0_t352_v310', 'r1_t588_v452', 'r2_t275_v2667', 'r0_t588_v320') (target: the task's token); key-value ('ident32', 'rand32', 'rand1') (target: the (V,) table at the key, trigger = the key position half, marker at half - 1). Cross null: a ' http' (3944) fine-tune by the same recipe.

measurements.rho_x: (lo_x - L00) / (L01 - L00), pattern x at the trigger and W0's gates elsewhere (commute.regating)
measurements.R_mean_net: (rho_mean - rho_mean_W0) / rho_trig: the updated model's mean trigger values over the training windows, net of W0's mean values, as a share of each window's own values (E18 amendment 1's mean pattern net of its reference). This is the number the decision report's '0.70 to 0.86 on three tasks' quotes
measurements.R_shared: rho_shared / rho_trig, E18's filed shared pattern clip(g0(x) + s); reported, not scored. Note: it read 0.73, 0.41, 0.62 on E18's three tasks, so scoring it at 0.5 would already have killed H' on r1_t534, a task the decision report counts as support
measurements.R_shuffled: mean over 20 draws of rho(clip(g0(x) + s_perm)) / rho_trig, s_perm = s permuted among each matrix's alive subcomponents (recruit.shuffled, seed = draw): E18 amendment 2
measurements.R_other: mean over 5 derangements pi of rho(g1(pi(x))) / rho_trig; reference R_other_W0 the same for g0(pi(x)): E18 amendment 3's mismatch level

gates.G1_control: emoticon: |r - E18 seed 0 (0.5972)| <= 0.05; rho trig, shared, mean within 0.02 of E18 seed 0 (0.973, 0.715, 0.896); W0's gates through trig and shared recover <= 1e-06; R_shuffled within 0.02 of E18 amendment 2 (tasks.emoticon.seeds.0.perm.shared.R_mean, 0.0023); R_other and R_other_W0 within 0.02 of E18 amendment 3 (tasks.emoticon.seeds.0.mismatch.R 0.887, .R_W0 0.007). First, alone; fail: stop
gates.G2_task: the do-nothing r within 0.1 of the on-disk reference (ladder.json tasks.<t>.do_nothing.routes.shares.r; kv_task.json tasks.<t>.do_nothing.routes.shares.r). Fail: reported, not scored

scorable: G2 passes, gain >= 1.0 nat, gap L01 - L00 >= 0.5 nats, rho_trig >= 0.5

expected.W0: every recovery 0 exactly (s = 0, g1 = g0); R_other_W0 is the reference, not 0
expected.control (emoticon): r 0.60, rho_trig 0.97, R_mean_net 0.81, R_shared 0.73, R_shuffled 0.002, R_other 0.89 (reference 0.007), rho_cross -0.18, random about 0
expected.under H': R_mean_net 0.7 to 0.9 (E18 0.70 to 0.86); R_shuffled within 0.03 of 0 (E18 -0.026 to +0.003); R_other 0.85 to 1.0 (E18 0.89 to 1.00)
